candidates.change_summary: Delete the assignment 'MinSum = _val;' so SetMinSum never updates MinSum.
Change 'MinSum = _val;' to 'MinSum = _val + 1;' so the stored value differs from the input.
Invert the guard to 'if(!intitalized)revert();' so the setter only works after initialization, and earlier calls revert leaving MinSum unchanged.
Delete 'locked_ = false;' so after the first nonReentrant_ call completes, locked_ stays true and every subsequent SetMinSum reverts, leaving MinSum at its earlier value.
Delete the statement `MinSum = _val;` so SetMinSum never updates the MinSum state variable.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = _val + 1;` so the stored MinSum always differs from the argument.
Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` check so SetMinSum can overwrite MinSum after initialization, changing the observable value.
Delete the assignment `Log = LogFile(_log);` so the Log state variable is never set.
Replace the assignment with `Log = LogFile(address(this));` so Log is set to the contract's own address instead of _log.
Invert the guard condition to `if(!intitalized)revert();` so the call reverts before assigning Log when not yet initialized.
Replace `require(!locked_);` with `require(locked_);` so the nonReentrant_ modifier reverts and Log is never assigned.
Delete the statement that sets intitalized to true, so calling Initialized no longer finalizes the contract.
Replace the assignment `intitalized = true;` with `intitalized = false;` so Initialized keeps the contract unfinalized.
Drop the nonReentrant_ modifier from Initialized so it no longer participates in the reentrancy lock.
Change the post-statement reset `locked_ = false;` to `locked_ = true;` so the lock is never released and any subsequent Initialized call reverts.
Delete the `require(!locked_);` guard so reentrant calls to Initialized during an in-flight Collect succeed instead of reverting.
